items.title: Calculating Real ROI for How To Calculate the Real ROI of Customer Support Automation
items.description:
Customer support automation ROI is net savings divided by total cost. The hard part is counting only tickets the AI actually resolves, and every cost it brings with it.

This guide walks through the formula, the costs most business cases leave out, and a worked example you can adapt.
